independent_documentation.source: SWAP version 4, Theory description and user manual, Wageningen Environmental Research report 2780
independent_documentation.statement: SWKMEAN=1 is the unweighted arithmetic mean of hydraulic conductivity.

derivative_crosscheck.observation: For swkmean==1, derivative with respect to either conductivity is 0.5, consistent with an unweighted arithmetic mean.

bound_face_flux.sign: positive downward for the C1 normalized diagnostic
bound_face_flux.geometry: fine Reference uses adjacent 10-cm cells, so distance=10 cm at the interior faces used by C1
bound_face_flux.pressure_head: SWAP conventional pressure head h; equivalent to the CA1 positive capillary-head form after h=-psi sign normalization

limitations: Bound only for the DYN0A homogeneous B01, swkmean=1, swkimpl=0 fine-Reference diagnostic.
Does not authorize a general alternative SWAP face-flux implementation.
C1 may use this only as an oracle diagnostic; it is not a reduced-model closure.
